module_summary: I2C-slave to AXI-lite master bridge: an i2c_slave child streams bytes to a 6-state FSM that loads an auto-incrementing address register, assembles bytes into words with strobes, and issues AXI-lite reads/writes.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: Bridge FSM: idle, address load, read issue/send, write assemble/wait

anchors.name: count_reg
anchors.why: Byte counter indexing address bytes and byte lanes of the data word

anchors.name: addr_reg
anchors.why: Auto-incrementing AXI address pointer loaded from I2C header bytes

anchors.name: data_reg
anchors.why: Word buffer: assembles write bytes, holds read word for byte-wise return

anchors.name: m_axil_wstrb_reg
anchors.why: Byte strobes set per received write byte

anchors.name: last_cycle_reg
anchors.why: Latched last-byte flag ending write sequence after response

anchors.name: m_axil_awvalid
anchors.why: AXI write address valid when a word is assembled

anchors.name: m_axil_wvalid
anchors.why: AXI write data valid issued with awvalid

anchors.name: m_axil_bvalid
anchors.why: Write response completes STATE_WRITE_2 and bumps address

anchors.name: m_axil_bready
anchors.why: Write response ready held while waiting for completion

anchors.name: m_axil_arvalid
anchors.why: AXI read address valid issued on I2C read request

anchors.name: m_axil_rvalid
anchors.why: Read data valid capturing m_axil_rdata into data_reg

anchors.name: m_axil_rready
anchors.why: Read data ready asserted in STATE_READ_1

anchors.name: m_axil_rdata
anchors.why: AXI read data loaded into word buffer

anchors.name: m_axil_awready
anchors.why: Clears pending write address valid

anchors.name: m_axil_wready
anchors.why: Clears pending write data valid

anchors.name: m_axil_arready
anchors.why: Clears pending read address valid

anchors.name: data_out_valid
anchors.why: Received I2C byte valid from slave; starts address/write sequences

anchors.name: data_out
anchors.why: Received I2C byte stored into address or data registers

anchors.name: data_out_ready_reg
anchors.why: Accept ready for received I2C bytes

anchors.name: data_out_last
anchors.why: End of I2C write transaction; ends address or write phase

anchors.name: data_in_reg
anchors.why: Read byte sent to I2C slave from data_reg

anchors.name: data_in_valid_reg
anchors.why: Read byte valid toward I2C slave

anchors.name: data_in_ready
anchors.why: I2C slave requests read byte; triggers AXI read or next byte

anchors.name: bus_addressed
anchors.why: Device addressed indication; loss returns read FSM to idle

anchors.name: busy_reg
anchors.why: Busy level when FSM not idle, drives busy port

groups.name: I2C slave front-end
groups.description: i2c_slave child converting I2C bus to byte streams in both directions

groups.name: Bridge controller
groups.description: FSM sequencing address load, AXI reads and word-assembled writes

groups.name: Address and data registers
groups.description: Address pointer and word buffer with byte strobes feeding AXI channels

groups.name: AXI-lite master
groups.description: AW/W/B and AR/R handshake registers driven by the FSM
